from pathlib import Path
problems = []
core = Path("prompts/_shared/core-directives.xml").read_text()
start = core.index("<desk_orchestration id=\"PD-7\"")
end = core.index("</desk_orchestration>", start)
pd7 = core[start:end]
for n in [
  "Ove messages LEAD 1:1",
  "id=\"4d78b294-5b65-46a9-bec9-86cdbc54aa3e\"",
  "SendToAgent to that channel id",
  "Never SendToUser",
  "widgets/cards do not render in group rooms",
  "numbered choices",
  "priority false",
  "priority true for narrative status",
]:
  if n not in pd7:
    problems.append("PD-7 missing: " + n)
if "only human-visible surface" not in core:
  problems.append("desk_channel_discipline sentence missing")
if "Numbered selectable options live in the Desk" not in core:
  problems.append("numbered desk rule missing")
specialists = [
  "prompts/bot-01-systems-backend.xml",
  "prompts/bot-02-web-edge.xml",
  "prompts/bot-03-android.xml",
  "prompts/bot-04-ios.xml",
  "prompts/bot-05-infrastructure.xml",
  "prompts/bot-06-quality-security.xml",
]
for p in specialists:
  t = Path(p).read_text()
  bstart = t.index("<desk_membership>")
  bend = t.index("</desk_membership>", bstart)
  block = t[bstart:bend]
  for n in [
    "role=\"human_visible_surface\"",
    "Only human-visible surface",
    "numbered selectable-option prompts",
    "Widgets/cards do not render in group rooms",
    "SendToAgent LEAD priority false",
    "selectable-option widget in a private 1:1",
    "Never SendToAgent LEAD priority true",
    "4d78b294-5b65-46a9-bec9-86cdbc54aa3e",
  ]:
    if n not in block:
      problems.append(p + " missing: " + n)
lead = Path("prompts/bot-00-programming-lead.xml").read_text()
for n in [
  "Ove messages YOU 1:1",
  "human-visible voice is Programming Desk only",
  "surface a true widget",
  "rooms cannot render widgets",
  "held (priority false)",
  "4d78b294-5b65-46a9-bec9-86cdbc54aa3e",
  "Expect specialist human-visible replies in the Desk",
]:
  if n not in lead:
    problems.append("bot-00 missing: " + n)
doc = Path("docs/desk-operating-model.md").read_text()
for n in [
  "## Channel discipline (human-visible surface)",
  "Ove messages **LEAD** 1:1",
  "4d78b294-5b65-46a9-bec9-86cdbc54aa3e",
  "widgets/cards do **not** render in group rooms",
  "numbered text choices",
  "LEAD↔Ove 1:1",
  "priority: false",
]:
  if n not in doc:
    problems.append("operating model missing: " + n)
pairs = [
  ("bot-00-programming-lead", "LEAD"),
  ("bot-01-systems-backend", "SYSTEMS"),
  ("bot-02-web-edge", "WEB"),
  ("bot-03-android", "ANDROID"),
  ("bot-04-ios", "IOS"),
  ("bot-05-infrastructure", "INFRA"),
  ("bot-06-quality-security", "QUALITY"),
]
for bot, seat in pairs:
  a = Path("prompts-assembled/" + seat + ".xml").read_text()
  b = Path("prompts/" + seat + ".xml").read_text()
  src = Path("prompts/" + bot + ".xml").read_text()
  if a != b:
    problems.append("prompts/" + seat + ".xml != prompts-assembled/" + seat + ".xml")
  if "{{BOT_ID}}" in a or "{{DEFAULT_BRANCH}}" in a:
    problems.append("unsubstituted placeholder in " + seat)
  if (".receipts/" + bot + "/") not in a:
    problems.append("BOT_ID not substituted in " + seat)
  if "<default_branch>main</default_branch>" not in a:
    problems.append("DEFAULT_BRANCH not substituted in " + seat)
  if "Ove messages LEAD 1:1" not in a:
    problems.append("PD-7 missing from assembled " + seat)
  if not a.rstrip("\n").endswith(src.rstrip("\n")):
    problems.append("seat body is not the suffix of assembled " + seat)
print(problems or "ok")
raise SystemExit(0 if not problems else 1)
'

python3 -c '
import hashlib, os, pathlib, subprocess
files = [
  "prompts-assembled/LEAD.xml", "prompts/LEAD.xml",
  "prompts-assembled/SYSTEMS.xml", "prompts/SYSTEMS.xml",
  "prompts-assembled/WEB.xml", "prompts/WEB.xml",
  "prompts-assembled/ANDROID.xml", "prompts/ANDROID.xml",
  "prompts-assembled/IOS.xml", "prompts/IOS.xml",
  "prompts-assembled/INFRA.xml", "prompts/INFRA.xml",
  "prompts-assembled/QUALITY.xml", "prompts/QUALITY.xml",
]
def digests():
    return {f: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in files}
before = digests()
env = os.environ.copy()
env["DEFAULT_BRANCH"] = "main"
r = subprocess.run(["bash", "scripts/assemble-prompts.sh"], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
after = digests()
changed = [f for f in files if before[f] != after[f]]
print({"assemble_exit": r.returncode, "changed": changed})
raise SystemExit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and not changed else 1)
'
